# Microsoft Q&A

> > Microsoft's official community-driven question and answer platform for technical support across developer tools, cloud services, and enterprise products.

Microsoft Q&A serves as the central hub for community-based technical assistance, replacing the legacy MSDN and TechNet forums. It provides peer-to-peer and expert support for Microsoft's ecosystem including .NET, Azure, Microsoft 365, Visual Studio, and other enterprise technologies.

## Key Topics

- Microsoft Q&A
- Microsoft Learn
- .NET
- Azure
- Microsoft Entra
- Microsoft 365
